 Oral Order

Heard Mr. Krishna Pd. Singh, learned senior counsel, along with Mr. Saket Kumar, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and Mr. Aditya Narayan Singh.1, learned APP appearing on behalf of the State.
2.
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Bikramganj P.S. Case No. 639 of 2023 registered under Sections 376, 354, 323, 504 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the allegation made, the petitioner on the pretext of marriage done wrong with the complainant and she has accepted in the complaint that she is a major.

4. Mr. Krishna Pd. Singh, learned senior counsel, along with Mr. Saket Kumar, learned counsel appearing on Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.28312 of 2024(2) dt.15-05-2024 behalf of the petitioner submits that consensual sex between two adults can not be held to be a crime.
The complainant has admitted the fact that she used to take contraceptive pills and she was in live-in-relationship with the petitioner.

He further submitted that even if the oral contract of Tabish Kha @ Md. Tabish Khan @ Tabish Khan vs The State Of Bihar on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68067283/
1 marriage is accepted, the same is not substantiated in view of the fact that the complainant was in a physical relationship with the petitioner, as per her own desire.

6. Considering the aforesaid submissions made on behalf of the parties, I find it proper to issue notice to the Opposite Party No.2, both by ordinary process, as also by registered post with A/D, for which requisites etc. must be filed within a period of two weeks after Annual Vacation.

7. Call for the up to date legible carbon/photocopy of the case diary and statement made under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Bikramganj P.S. Case No. 639 of 2023 from the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-Ist, Bikramganj, Rohtas.
8.
